portalsFound.observation: Official Delhi land-record portal links its GIS Map to http://gsdl.org.in/revenue/. The landing page itself does not return a parcel list.
Delhi Revenue Geo Portal is the most promising map source, but both HTTP and HTTPS timed out during this pass. Its parcel service and reuse terms remain unknown.
Official downloadable revenue district maps are PDF documents, not a parcel-list API.
NIC public ArcGIS directory lists a Delhi folder, but its metadata request timed out. No cadastral layer was verified.
L&DO e-Dharti map presents selected government lease/property layers; it is not evidence of complete Delhi cadastral parcel coverage.

requests.observation: Official HTML landing page; GIS link points to http://gsdl.org.in/revenue/.

spatialNote: UN ranking uses the New Delhi urban area, whereas GeoNames 1261481 marks the New Delhi locality. A point or service limited to that locality must not be assumed to cover the wider urban area.
remainingUncertainty: The linked Delhi revenue GIS map may expose parcel geometries when available. No HTTP 200 nonempty parcel response was obtained, so this is an availability/research gap rather than a finding that Delhi lacks an open source.
nextStep: Retry the revenue GIS map and NIC Delhi service directory; inspect any actual cadastral layer and its terms before assigning a source ID.
